source.note: ID inventory reflects the existing 11 questionnaire modules. Confirm labels/options against the live source before changing the UI.

compatibility_policy.wording_change: Keep ID only if construct, timeframe, and meaning are unchanged.
compatibility_policy.semantic_change: Create a new ID or increment semantic version and define explicit migration.
compatibility_policy.new_question: Missing answer means unanswered; never infer zero, false, normal, or absent.
compatibility_policy.option_values: Stable machine codes; labels may change, meanings may not be reassigned.
compatibility_policy.numeric_values: Require unit, precision, and question-specific bounds; flag invalid values rather than silently clamping.

structured_record.stored_value: array of timestamped records with item code, amount, unit, context
